headline: Strategic oil reserves: how long can the market hold out
summary: Strategic oil reserves exist but access to them is limited, according to the report on the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and its implications for prices, refineries and consumers.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil exports from the Gulf, so disruptions there move global crude prices.
why_moved: The article links the Hormuz blockade to prices, refineries and consumers, while access to strategic reserves is limited.
